FULL MOBILE APP · MODE OVERVIEW

Infinite

Infinite Feasts: Food is overrunning the land. Assign friends, reclaim plots, and expand carefully. Recruit and assign frog helpers, reclaim pressured plots, explore territory, and build stations. Infinite uses its own Colony Coins for recruitment skips, stations, exploration, and territory purchases.
